description: Edit a checklist item — change its text, assignee, resolved (checked) state, or nest it under a parent item. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated checklist.

assignee.description: User id to assign the item to, or null to clear the assignee. Omit to keep current.

checklist_id.description: ID of the checklist the item belongs to.

checklist_item_id.description: ID of the checklist item to edit.

name.description: New text for the item. Omit to keep current.

parent.description: ID of a parent checklist item to nest this one under, or null to un-nest it.

resolved.description: Set true to check (resolve) the item, false to uncheck it.

name: edit_checklist_item
